bagPolicy.summary: Any bag brought to the hall is searched and must measure no more than 12 × 10 × 10 inches. The venue does not store oversized bags.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Nearby city-street parking is free and first come, first served; paid lots are east along Willett Street between Madison and Monroe. Do not use private lots behind Dunkin’ or Domino’s.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue has a dedicated rideshare pickup and drop-off area just outside its entrance.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Two bars and food service operate inside; the bars accept major credit cards only. Outside food and drinks are prohibited except for medical or special needs raised with security on arrival.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Limited ADA parking, wheelchair-accessible bathrooms and ADA viewing accommodations are available; ask venue staff for help when you arrive.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The venue FAQ discusses the outside smoking patio but does not state a rule for leaving the property and re-entering.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will Call tickets are available at the box office in the atrium of the Minglewood building, 1555 Madison Avenue. It opens two hours before each show and Fridays 1–6 p.m.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Check the specific event page for door and show times, which vary; allow extra time for security screening. A valid government photo ID is needed for 18+ or 21+ shows.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
